data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall prioryears deterioration of GBP 1.776m (gross), representing a small strengthening of reserves. This adverse movement was driven primarily by a GBP 3.356m deterioration in the fire and other damage to property class, partially offset by favourable development in marine, aviation and transport (GBP 1.275m) and in reinsurance acceptances (GBP 0.344m). The reserve movement is therefore a net strengthening concentrated in property exposures with offsets in marine and reinsurance portfolios.

Component numbers (3,356k deterioration, 1,275k improvement, 344k improvement) sum to GBP 1,737k which differs slightly from the stated overall GBP 1,776k (small rounding/omissions). Claims development triangle (gross) is present and has been captured; the table includes a 'Before 2011' aggregate column which has been excluded from the per-year column list per instructions. All monetary figures converted from GBP '000 to millions where indicated. Confidence is high for extracted figures as they are explicitly stated.
